MacTahoe Icon Theme by vinceliuice and contributors.

Source: user-supplied MacTahoe-icon-theme-main.zip. Upstream: https://github.com/vinceliuice/MacTahoe-icon-theme

Selected original SVG artwork is distributed unchanged. Symlink aliases were resolved into standalone SVG files. Original GPL-3.0 license, AUTHORS and README accompany the assets. manifest.json maps each exported name to its original archive path. Layout, transitions and interactions are implemented separately for this portfolio.
